title: Content Update 3.29.0 — Path of Exile: Curse of the Allflame

Mercenaries of Trarthus as a Core League: Talisman Revamp
Talismans have been long-neglected, and have lacked a meaningful place or purpose in Path of Exile. With this update we've made a number of changes to bring Talismans back to relevance.

Talismans now have special Enchantment Modifiers, rather than special Implicit Modifiers, and are no longer Corrupted by default. Talismans have a chance to drop from Red Beasts or Bestiary Bosses, and each Talisman is tied to a specific Beast.
Talismans cannot be Anointed, and their Enchantment Modifiers cannot be removed using the crafting bench option.
Old Talisman base types are no longer obtainable, but will still exist in Standard.
Non-Unique Talismans can no longer be obtained as rewards outside of Bestiary content, Divination Cards that grant Talismans, or Thane Jorgin's Betrayal Safehouse Rewards.
Thane Jorgin's Talisman Crafting Spree Betrayal Safehouse reward now offers regular Currency to craft the Talisman, instead of Tainted Currency.

Unique Talismans are no longer in the core drop pool. They instead now have a chance to drop from Bestiary Bosses or from a new Beast-crafting recipe to create a new Talisman, which requires The Black Mórrigan beast to craft.

The Blightwell Unique Talisman is now found on the Shield Crab Talisman base type (previously Clutching Talisman). It now has +50-100 to maximum Energy Shield (previously +20-30), and 10-15% increased Flask Effect Duration. Existing versions of this Unique are unaffected by these changes.

The Eyes of the Greatwolf Unique Talisman now generates with two random Enchantment Modifiers from other Talisman base types. It now has 50-100% increased Enchantment Modifier magnitudes (instead of Implicit Modifier magnitudes are doubled). These changes do not affect existing versions of the item.

The Natural Hierarchy Unique Talisman is now found on the Rhex Talisman base type (previously Rotfeather Talisman), and no longer has increased Damage for each specific Damage type. Instead, it now grants Gain 10-15% of Physical Damage as Extra Lightning Damage, Gain 15-20% of Lightning Damage as Extra Cold Damage, Gain 20-25% of Cold Damage as Extra Fire Damage, and Gain 25-30% of Fire Damage as Extra Chaos Damage. Existing versions of this Unique are unaffected by these changes.

The Rigwald's Curse Unique Talisman is now found on the Wolf Alpha Talisman base type (previously Wereclaw Talisman). It now has +5-10% to Unarmed Melee Attack Critical Strike Chance (previously +7%). Existing versions of this Unique are unaffected by these changes.
Bestiary Boss area levels will now match the level of the Red Beast used in the Blood Altar to create the portals.
In general, all Bestiary Bosses will now have greater Life than before, which is more comparative to the Life values on Bosses from other League mechanics.
The specific Body Armour Unique items from each Bestiary Boss will now only drop if the area level is 80 or higher.
The Bestiary craft to create a Rare Talisman has been replaced with a craft that Rerolls a Talisman base type, keeping the same Implicit and Explicit Modifiers.
The Bestiary craft to Transform an item from an Amulet into a Talisman has been replaced with a craft that creates an Imprint of a Rare Talisman.
The Primal Delirium Orb is no longer obtainable, but existing ones will still function in Standard Leagues.
Trinkets that had a chance to receive additional Talisman items when opening a Reward Chest in a Heist instead now grant a chance to receive additional Gold.
The Craicic Chimeral Beast has been renamed to Craicic Croaker, which is a much more fitting name for a Gem Frog.
League Changes: The average number of Monsters in Breach Monster packs has been reduced.
The number of Monster packs spawned in Unstable Breaches has been reduced by 25%. The progress for killing Breach Monsters has been increased by 17% to compensate for the reduced number of Monsters.
The maximum number of Unstable Breaches that can be open at once has been reduced to 2 (previously 3).
The Swelling Ranks Atlas Passive Skill now grants Breach Monsters in your Maps have 10% increased Pack Size (previously 20%).
Small Passives that granted Breach Monsters in your Maps have 5% increased Pack Size instead now grant Breaches in your Maps spawn 5% increased Rare Monsters.
The Evolving Hives Atlas Passive Skill now grants Breaches in your Maps spawn 15% increased Rare and Magic Monsters (previously 25%).
Small Passives that granted Breaches in your Maps spawn 8% increased Magic Monsters now have values of 5%.
These changes do not affect the amount of Hiveblood or Wombgifts you receive.

Equipment Items birthed by the Genesis Tree inherently have slightly less Modifier Tier Rating and bias towards higher tier base types. There is also a lower inherent chance to birth additional Equipment items.
The maximum number of Equipment Genesis Tree Passive Points is now 16 (previously 20).
Small Equipment Genesis Tree Passives that grant a chance for Wombgifts to Birth an additional Equipment Item now have values of 25% (previously 50%).
Equipment Genesis Tree Notable Passives that grant increased chance for Modifiers of a specific type now have values of 300% (previously 500%).
Item Changes: The following Divination Cards have been temporarily disabled: Broken Promises, Imperfect Memories, Magnum Opus, and Parasitic Passengers. Existing Divination Cards cannot be turned in currently.
The Apocalypse Divination Card now states the reward is Corrupted. This is purely a descriptive change, the functionality has not been changed.
The Call to the First Ones Divination Card now awards a Rare Talisman.
The Catch and Matryoshka Divination Card rewards are no longer Incubated.
The Home Divination Card now awards an Exceptional Support Gem.
The Curse of the Allflame Challenge Leag: Meet Valerie, a dangerous corsair captain who needs your help retrieving long forgotten treasures from the icy depths of Wraeclast's oceans. Find Charts scattered across Wraeclast, board The Sovereign, and set sail!

Dive to the ocean floor where lanterns imbued with the spark of the Allflame will shield you from the crushing waves. Explore and claim what you can while you can! Lost gold, valuable chests, and lurking threats await you...

Upon charting enough areas, connect them together to create a Voyage — one giant seafloor excursion. Revisit each chart to claim its rewards again, while also amplifying those rewards in several different ways.
Head belowdecks, and you'll find the heart of the ship at work. Feed it an item, and it will split into a multitude of ghostly outcomes, one of which you can keep for yourself.
Find valuable Ducats on the seafloor and use them to warp and twist items in ways not seen in centuries.

With 3.29.0, there are Standard, Hardcore and Solo Self-Found variations of the Curse of the Allflame challenge league available. They have the same core mechanics and items. You can create private league versions of these leagues, with mods that make the game harder.

The Hardcore variations of Curse of the Allflame are parented to their Standard Curse of the Allflame equivalent, meaning if you die in Hardcore Curse of the Allflame you can continue on in the Standard Curse of the Alfflame League.

The new Curse of the Allflame challenge league includes a set of 40 new challenges, and 8 new challenges in Ruthless Curse of the Allflame. There are microtransaction rewards for completing challenges that are only obtainable in this league. These rewards will be revealed in an upcoming news post.

From the 19th challenge onwards and for every third challenge after that, you will receive pieces of the Curse of the Allflame Totem Pole decoration to display in your hideout. The Totem Pole permanently showcases how many of the Curse of the Allflame challenges you completed during the league.

Added a new Exceptional Skill Gem, Pact of Beidat: Cast a pact, Empowering spells that either fire projectiles, apply an effect to an area around a targeted location or fire chaining beams, causing them deal more damage and have enhanced coverage. However, using this skill also burdens you with an Affliction.

Added a new Exceptional Skill Gem, Pact of Ghorr: Cast a pact, Empowering your damage over time spells but burdening you with an Affliction. This skill also grants the Hunger of Ghorr buff for a duration causing Fleshrend to trigger periodically.

Added a new Exceptional Skill Gem, Pact of K'tash: Cast a pact, Empowering your damaging Vaal spells but burdening you with an Affliction. Empowered Vaal spells deal more damage, have less soul gain prevention duration and refund souls on use.

Added a new Exceptional Skill Gem, Pact of Lycia: Cast a pact, Empowering the next channelling spells you cast yourself but burdening you with an Affliction. Empowered spells deal more damage and periodically trigger lightning bolts while channelling.

Added a new Exceptional Support Gem, Coursing Currents: Supports skills that hit enemies, providing increased effect of Chill and Shock inflicted with Supported Skills, causing enemies to be chilled when they are shocked by your hits, and shocked when they are chilled by your hits.

Added a new Exceptional Support Gem, Crystalfall: Supported Skills will Trigger Falling Crystal on Hit, causing a giant crystal of abyssal soulstone to be called from above, falling to slam down at the targeted location. Supports Slam skills. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you.

Added a new Intelligence/Strength Skill, Mana-Infused Staff: Infuses your staff with arcane energy, lowering your mana costs and increasing your chance to block. When you block, you release an arcane wave, damaging enemies in a ring-shaped area over a duration.

Added a new Strength/Intelligence Transfigured Skill, Divine Blast of Radiance: Project a beam of holy light from your shield to a targeted location, causing an implosion of holy energy. This energy then lingers for a short duration as an orb, periodically releasing larger explosions. Increases and reductions to attack speed affect the rate at which explosions occur.

Added a new Strength/Intelligence Transfigured Skill, Holy Hammers of Spirals: Slam the ground, consuming all Power Charges and calling down a cascade of holy hammers from above in an outward spiral. Further hammers are called down for each Power Charge consumed. Requires a Mace, Sceptre or Staff.

Added a new Strength/Intelligence Transfigured Skill, Holy Sweep of Hammerfalls: Swings a two handed mace or a staff in a circle, calling down waves of holy hammers for a duration. Increases and reductions to Attack Speed will affect the rate at which these hammerfalls occur.

Added a new Strength/Intelligence Transfigured Skill, Reap of Butchery: A bloody scythe swipes around you, applying a physical damage over time debuff and hitting enemies with physical damage. If any survive, you gain a blood charge which raises the damage and cost of the skill. Players can have 5 maximum blood charges.

Endgame Changes: Strange locations have begun to manifest on the Atlas, which Kirac has labelled as Anomalies.
Upon completing Maps affected by a Voidstone, there is a chance that when you next open your Atlas an Anomaly may manifest. Atlas Anomalies do not require a Map item to enter.

Atlas Anomalies are unaffected by your Atlas Passive Tree, and cannot be augmented using any Fragments, allowing them to be run at any time without feeling like they have to be saved for later to maximise potential rewards.

Reflect Map Modifiers have been reworked, instead of causing Monsters to Reflect a percentage of Physical or Elemental Hit Damage dealt to them, they instead cause Rare Monsters to have Physical or Elemental Thorns.

Physical Thorns activates when Hit by Physical Damage and lasts for 5 seconds. While active, it reflects a fixed amount of Physical Damage each time the monster receives a Physical Hit. Monsters cannot gain Physical Thorns more than once every 10 seconds. You can only take Physical Thorns damage once every 0.1 seconds.

Elemental Thorns activates when Hit by Elemental Damage and lasts for 5 seconds. While active, it reflects a fixed amount of Elemental Damage each time the monster receives an Elemental Hit, dealing Damage of the highest Elemental Damage type in the received Hit. Monsters cannot gain Elemental Thorns more than once every 10 seconds. You can only take Elemental Thorns damage once every 0.1 seconds.
In Red Tier Maps, Rare Monsters have Physical Thorns reflecting 800 Physical Damage and Elemental Thorns reflecting 1500 Elemental Damage.
Reflected Damage from Thorns is able to be mitigated through Evasion, Block, Armour, Resistances, etc.
Reflect Modifiers no longer appear on Corrupted Side Areas in the Campaign.

The Mystical Infusion Notable Passive Skill no longer grants Base Spell Critical Strike Chance of Spells is equal to that of Main Hand Weapon. It now grants Spell Critical Strike Chance Bifurcates, and 50% less Spell Critical Strike Chance.
Bifurcated Critical Strikes cause Critical Strike chance to be rolled twice when determining if a Critical Strike should occur:

If either roll succeeds the hit will be a regular Critical Strike, and if both rolls succeed the amount of extra damage dealt by the critical strike will be doubled. This is equivalent to doubling the amount by which the Critical Strike Multiplier exceeds 100 for that Hit.
If a modifier makes your Critical Strike Chance Lucky or Unlucky, that luck will apply individually to each of the critical strike chance rolls.
Effects which cause Hits to Always be Critical Strikes prevent Bifurcation - those hits do not roll the chance, so cannot roll it twice.

endgame_changes: Strange locations have begun to manifest on the Atlas, which Kirac has labelled as Anomalies.
Upon completing Maps affected by a Voidstone, there is a chance that when you next open your Atlas an Anomaly may manifest. Atlas Anomalies do not require a Map item to enter.
Reflecting Mists and the Nameless Seer no longer randomly spawn within Maps, but instead now appear in their own Anomaly areas.

Atlas Anomalies are unaffected by your Atlas Passive Tree, and cannot be augmented using any Fragments, allowing them to be run at any time without feeling like they have to be saved for later to maximise potential rewards.

Reflect Map Modifiers have been reworked, instead of causing Monsters to Reflect a percentage of Physical or Elemental Hit Damage dealt to them, they instead cause Rare Monsters to have Physical or Elemental Thorns.

Physical Thorns activates when Hit by Physical Damage and lasts for 5 seconds. While active, it reflects a fixed amount of Physical Damage each time the monster receives a Physical Hit. Monsters cannot gain Physical Thorns more than once every 10 seconds. You can only take Physical Thorns damage once every 0.1 seconds.

Elemental Thorns activates when Hit by Elemental Damage and lasts for 5 seconds. While active, it reflects a fixed amount of Elemental Damage each time the monster receives an Elemental Hit, dealing Damage of the highest Elemental Damage type in the received Hit. Monsters cannot gain Elemental Thorns more than once every 10 seconds. You can only take Elemental Thorns damage once every 0.1 seconds.
In Red Tier Maps, Rare Monsters have Physical Thorns reflecting 800 Physical Damage and Elemental Thorns reflecting 1500 Elemental Damage.
Reflected Damage from Thorns is able to be mitigated through Evasion, Block, Armour, Resistances, etc.
Reflect Modifiers no longer appear on Corrupted Side Areas in the Campaign.

The following Maps have been added back to the Atlas: Arachnid Nest, Basilica, Bazaar, Caldera, Cells, Channel, Colonnade, Colosseum, Conservatory, Crystal Ore, Desert, Desert Spring, Estuary, Forbidden Woods, Geode, Infested Valley, Laboratory, Malformation, Museum, Phantasmagoria, Pier, Plateau, Ramparts, Stagnation, Sunken City, Temple, Toxic Sewer, and Vault.

The following Maps have been removed from the Atlas: Acid Caverns, Arena, Ashen Wood, Bog, Canyon, Carcass, Castle Ruins, Courtyard, Coves, Crimson Temple, Crimson Township, Cursed Crypt, Defiled Cathedral, Dig, Dry Sea, Dungeon, Lava Chamber, Lighthouse, Maze, Moon Temple, Mud Geyser, Necropolis, Pen, Racecourse, Sepulchre, Underground Sea, Wasteland, and Wharf.
The Untainted Paradise Unique Map can no longer be obtained, and existing items cannot be used in Standard Leagues.
Untainted Paradise can now be accessed through a randomly spawned event node on your Atlas, where it has received a few alterations to make it more difficult and rewarding...
The Decayed Voidstone socket on the Atlas now connects to the Forge of the Phoenix, Pit of the Chimera and Lair of the Hydra (in addition to the Maze of the Minotaur).
The Pit of the Chimera Boss now spawns only one wave of enemies per phase.
Memory Thread Maps now display which Map they will open.

The Mystical Infusion Notable Passive Skill no longer grants Base Spell Critical Strike Chance of Spells is equal to that of Main Hand Weapon. It now grants Spell Critical Strike Chance Bifurcates, and 50% less Spell Critical Strike Chance.
Bifurcated Critical Strikes cause Critical Strike chance to be rolled twice when determining if a Critical Strike should occur:

If either roll succeeds the hit will be a regular Critical Strike, and if both rolls succeed the amount of extra damage dealt by the critical strike will be doubled. This is equivalent to doubling the amount by which the Critical Strike Multiplier exceeds 100 for that Hit.
If a modifier makes your Critical Strike Chance Lucky or Unlucky, that luck will apply individually to each of the critical strike chance rolls.
Effects which cause Hits to Always be Critical Strikes prevent Bifurcation - those hits do not roll the chance, so cannot roll it twice.

player_changes: Sources of chance to Avoid all Damage from Hits are now additive with sources of Avoiding Damage of a specific Type from Hits. Some Damage Avoidance stat descriptions have been adjusted to better communicate these chances are additive with each other.

mercenaries_of_trarthus_as_a_core_league: Talisman Revamp
Talismans have been long-neglected, and have lacked a meaningful place or purpose in Path of Exile. With this update we've made a number of changes to bring Talismans back to relevance.

Talismans now have special Enchantment Modifiers, rather than special Implicit Modifiers, and are no longer Corrupted by default. Talismans have a chance to drop from Red Beasts or Bestiary Bosses, and each Talisman is tied to a specific Beast.
Talismans cannot be Anointed, and their Enchantment Modifiers cannot be removed using the crafting bench option.
Old Talisman base types are no longer obtainable, but will still exist in Standard.
Non-Unique Talismans can no longer be obtained as rewards outside of Bestiary content, Divination Cards that grant Talismans, or Thane Jorgin's Betrayal Safehouse Rewards.
Thane Jorgin's Talisman Crafting Spree Betrayal Safehouse reward now offers regular Currency to craft the Talisman, instead of Tainted Currency.

Unique Talismans are no longer in the core drop pool. They instead now have a chance to drop from Bestiary Bosses or from a new Beast-crafting recipe to create a new Talisman, which requires The Black Mórrigan beast to craft.

The Blightwell Unique Talisman is now found on the Shield Crab Talisman base type (previously Clutching Talisman). It now has +50-100 to maximum Energy Shield (previously +20-30), and 10-15% increased Flask Effect Duration. Existing versions of this Unique are unaffected by these changes.

The Eyes of the Greatwolf Unique Talisman now generates with two random Enchantment Modifiers from other Talisman base types. It now has 50-100% increased Enchantment Modifier magnitudes (instead of Implicit Modifier magnitudes are doubled). These changes do not affect existing versions of the item.

The Natural Hierarchy Unique Talisman is now found on the Rhex Talisman base type (previously Rotfeather Talisman), and no longer has increased Damage for each specific Damage type. Instead, it now grants Gain 10-15% of Physical Damage as Extra Lightning Damage, Gain 15-20% of Lightning Damage as Extra Cold Damage, Gain 20-25% of Cold Damage as Extra Fire Damage, and Gain 25-30% of Fire Damage as Extra Chaos Damage. Existing versions of this Unique are unaffected by these changes.

The Rigwald's Curse Unique Talisman is now found on the Wolf Alpha Talisman base type (previously Wereclaw Talisman). It now has +5-10% to Unarmed Melee Attack Critical Strike Chance (previously +7%). Existing versions of this Unique are unaffected by these changes.
Bestiary Boss area levels will now match the level of the Red Beast used in the Blood Altar to create the portals.
In general, all Bestiary Bosses will now have greater Life than before, which is more comparative to the Life values on Bosses from other League mechanics.
The specific Body Armour Unique items from each Bestiary Boss will now only drop if the area level is 80 or higher.
The Bestiary craft to create a Rare Talisman has been replaced with a craft that Rerolls a Talisman base type, keeping the same Implicit and Explicit Modifiers.
The Bestiary craft to Transform an item from an Amulet into a Talisman has been replaced with a craft that creates an Imprint of a Rare Talisman.
The Primal Delirium Orb is no longer obtainable, but existing ones will still function in Standard Leagues.
Trinkets that had a chance to receive additional Talisman items when opening a Reward Chest in a Heist instead now grant a chance to receive additional Gold.
The Craicic Chimeral Beast has been renamed to Craicic Croaker, which is a much more fitting name for a Gem Frog.
the_curse_of_the_allflame_challenge_leag: Meet Valerie, a dangerous corsair captain who needs your help retrieving long forgotten treasures from the icy depths of Wraeclast's oceans. Find Charts scattered across Wraeclast, board The Sovereign, and set sail!

Dive to the ocean floor where lanterns imbued with the spark of the Allflame will shield you from the crushing waves. Explore and claim what you can while you can! Lost gold, valuable chests, and lurking threats await you...

Upon charting enough areas, connect them together to create a Voyage — one giant seafloor excursion. Revisit each chart to claim its rewards again, while also amplifying those rewards in several different ways.
Head belowdecks, and you'll find the heart of the ship at work. Feed it an item, and it will split into a multitude of ghostly outcomes, one of which you can keep for yourself.
Find valuable Ducats on the seafloor and use them to warp and twist items in ways not seen in centuries.

With 3.29.0, there are Standard, Hardcore and Solo Self-Found variations of the Curse of the Allflame challenge league available. They have the same core mechanics and items. You can create private league versions of these leagues, with mods that make the game harder.

The Hardcore variations of Curse of the Allflame are parented to their Standard Curse of the Allflame equivalent, meaning if you die in Hardcore Curse of the Allflame you can continue on in the Standard Curse of the Alfflame League.

The new Curse of the Allflame challenge league includes a set of 40 new challenges, and 8 new challenges in Ruthless Curse of the Allflame. There are microtransaction rewards for completing challenges that are only obtainable in this league. These rewards will be revealed in an upcoming news post.

From the 19th challenge onwards and for every third challenge after that, you will receive pieces of the Curse of the Allflame Totem Pole decoration to display in your hideout. The Totem Pole permanently showcases how many of the Curse of the Allflame challenges you completed during the league.
